label: copy phase, late steps (t>=11), input d/n/a/k
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (100% of mass; never in the original phase, almost never at <DEL>), mostly for recall_idx >= 3 in long sequences (L=8-9 carry ~80% of mass; t=12-13 is the peak). It is strongly selective for the fed-back input token: d (9.5x lift, 36% of mass) and n (5.9x), then a, k, w, o, 2, c, i; it is nearly silent on v, l, u. The output token also matters (higher for outputs c, a, n, y), and the strongest activations are d/n inputs followed by c/a/n/y outputs (precision about 0.6 for that pair, but low recall). Input-token set plus copy phase covers about 96% of mass but with precision near 0.1. Most steps that match the token and position condition do not fire, so the gate depends on sequence context that these variables do not capture. Magnitude is small (max 0.016) and largest for d or n inputs in the middle of the copy phase.
